name: Avenisse
summary: Avenisse is upholstered in refined fabric that brings texture, warmth, and sophistication to its form. The seamless surface enhances its proportions with quiet elegance, while slender matte black legs introduce contrast and grounding. Designed to balance softness with structure, it reflects a modern vision of comfort shaped through contemporary luxury. 230x208x95(180×200)
